thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Paging: elevated 504/502 gateway errors from api-gateway (5xx rate > 5% over 5m). Customers impacted: ~12% of requests. Correlation id sample: 0b3a7f1c-9df2-4c2a-bf8e-2e6d8a7a1234
emily: I'm oncall, starting timeline. When did this start?
raj: I see spike at 12:02 UTC in nginx metrics. 504s correlate with upstream retry errors. Investigating traces now.
maria: Runtime team — any recent deploys to gateway or runtime in last hour?
sam: Support reports multiple enterprise customers showing failures, one filed case with correlation id above. Customer impact: API calls failing, no fallback.
emily: Good. @raj can you paste sample logs (kvlog) and grep for corr ids? we need exact upstream error.
raj: Sharing logs snippet -> s3://redwood-incident-logs/2498765432/gateway_kvlog.txt
raj: Log snippet:
```
[12:02:14 UTC] correlation_id=0b3a7f1c-9df2-4c2a-bf8e-2e6d8a7a1234 path=/v1/generate status=504 upstream=runtime-1 connection_reset retries=2
[12:02:15 UTC] correlation_id=0b3a7f1c-9df2-4c2a-bf8e-2e6d8a7a1234 upstream_err=ERROR: remote closed stream
```
emily: Observed retries=2 -> gateway retried to runtime, then 504. Could be overload or upstream timeout.
maria: Runtime traces show spike in KV cache miss latencies around 12:01:50, sustained for ~3m. Traces link: https://traces.internal/redwood/trace/0b3a7f1c
sam: Customer timeline: first reported at 12:04. Impacted endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat_stream.
emily: Hypotheses (track):
1) Upstream runtime nodes overloaded -> increased latency -> gateway retries -> 504 amplification.
2) Network flakiness between gateway and runtime (connection resets) causing partial retry loops.
3) Recent config change to gateway retry ladder increasing retries and causing head-of-line blocking.
raj: Quick check: no infra deploys in last hour. There was a gateway config change 3 hours ago but not recent.
maria: I can pull runtime pod metrics. Starting 'kubectl top' across runtime-*.pods
raj: Meanwhile reduce gateway retry count to 1 for canary to see effect? Anyone ok with a conservative change?
emily: Approve conservative change in canary subset (10%). @maria do canary change or ops take?
maria: I can patch canary service to set retry=1 on route-policy for 10% traffic. Will update.
raj: Creating timeline doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/2498765432-timeline (will add events)
emily: Also pls run query to list top 5 correlation ids by frequency between 12:00-12:10.
raj: Query result:
- 0b3a7f1c-9df2-4c2a-bf8e-2e6d8a7a1234 (78 hits)
- 1f4b9a22-... (21 hits)
- 9a2c3d44-... (12 hits)
emily: That's high. Could be one customer causing amplification.
sam: Support: Customer A reports retries on 10k calls in that window.
emily: Mitigation plan: 1) apply canary retry tapering -> observing 2) temporarily enable route-shadowing to route heavy customers to secondary runtime cluster (if available) 3) throttle per-customer if needed.
maria: Canary patch applied at 12:07 UTC to 10% traffic, change id: canary-2498765432-1
raj: Monitoring: error rate in canary subset dropped from 6.8% to 0.9% in 30s. Full rollout not yet.
emily: Good signal. Continue monitoring for 10m. If stable, roll to 50% then 100%.
raj: Also found repeated connection resets at runtime-node-7 -> opening ticket for that node and draining.
maria: Draining runtime-node-7 now. Pod eviction in progress.
sam: Support: Notifying affected customers with incident id RED-2026-2498765432. Sending interim status.
emily: Assign owners: timeline/doc @raj, runtime mitigation @maria, customer comms @sam. Oncall handoff in 1h if still active.
incident-bot: Incident updated: severity=sev2, pagees=eng-oncall, eng-runtime. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/oncall/5xx
emily: Next steps: gather full kvlog tarball, attach to channel when ready. Also collect pcap if network suspicion remains.
raj: KV log tarball uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-logs/2498765432/kvlogs.tar.gz
maria: Runtime node drained and replaced. Observed no more connection resets after 12:12.
emily: Closing mitigation loop: fallback worked. We'll keep incident open for RCA. Please add causation notes to timeline doc and mark owners for RCA writeup.
sam: Support will prepare customer follow-up with root-cause summary once RCA is done. :thumbsup:
emily: Thanks team. Handoff to @maria for postmortem. I'll update #incidents when RCA draft is ready.
